A '''group of slicers''' operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were based in a [[Slicer House|building]] near [[Nym's Stronghold]].

==Dscription==
The [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] belonged to different species, including [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] and an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]]. They lived in a [[Slicer House|house]] located in the barren wilderness not far from [[Nym's Stronghold]].<ref name="SWG:relics" /> The building was filled with technology of all kinds, including computers, terminals, viewscreens and various droids.<ref name="SWG:GttSH" /> It was defended by several [[IG-106 assassin droid|IG-106]] sentry droids and all slicers were armed with small firearms. Members of this group included [[Kelson Sharphorn]], [[Skaelor Tay]] and [[Byd Chillings]], various quality assurance staff members and several slicer students.<ref name="SWG:relics" />

==History==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] technology-hating [[Meatlumps|Meatlump terrorists]] had expanded to Lok, establishing a small Meatlump camp near Nym's Stronghold.<ref name="SWG:MtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Muddle the Meatlumps|Corellia}}</ref> They planted an [[Bomb/Legends|explosive device]] in the slicers' house to destroy the building and the technology in it — most likely along with most of the slicers.<ref name="SWG:BTLNNS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Bomb Target - Lok, Near Nym's Stronghold|Corellia}}</ref>
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
However, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for ''[[Corellia Times]]'' [[Journalist/Legends|reporters]] [[Vani Korr]] and [[Halden Wes]] who had infiltrated the Meatlump gang discovered the plot.<ref name="SWG:BTLNNS" /> The spacer traveled to Lok, found the bomb in time and managed to defuse it.<ref name="SWG:MtM" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The slicer appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:relics" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The slicers and their house were added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref> The slicer NPCs were not part of any quest but they were indirectly involved in the so-called "[[:w:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]". In the basement of the house, there was a bomb that the player had to defuse as part of the quest "[[:w:c:swg:Muddle the Meatlumps|Muddle the Meatlumps]]." While there were several slicer NPC enemies in the house, none of them had to be killed for the mission, though it was likely that some of the NPCs would attack the player.<ref name="SWG:MtM" /> "[[:w:c:swg:Chronicle Relic|Chronicle Relics]]" could be looted from them. Such relics could be used by players in the [[:w:c:swg:Chronicle Quest|Chronicle Quest system]] to create their own quests for other players. By using the relics related to the slicer NPCs, the quests would task the player with killing slicer in the house,<ref name="SWG:relics" /> or just traveling to the house.<ref name="SWG:GttSH" />
